title: Flow Yoga vs BodyFix
meta_desc: Compare Flow Yoga & Wellbeing and BodyFix Gym NZ prices, contracts, facilities, and overall value to choose the best gym for your fitness needs in New Zealand.
intro: Flow Yoga & Wellbeing and BodyFix Gym NZ are two popular fitness options in New Zealand, catering to different needs and preferences. Flow Yoga specializes in hot yoga, infrared yoga, and wellness, while BodyFix Gym offers a wide range of group fitness classes and personal training. In this article, we'll compare these two options to help you decide which one is best for you.

sections.heading: Overview of Flow Yoga & Wellbeing and BodyFix Gym NZ
sections.body: Flow Yoga & Wellbeing is a boutique yoga studio with multiple heated studios, expert teaching, and a focus on wellness and relaxation. BodyFix Gym, on the other hand, is a full-service gym with a wide range of group fitness classes, personal training, and amenities like a crèche. Both options have their strengths and weaknesses, and the right choice for you will depend on your specific fitness goals and preferences.
list: Flow Yoga & Wellbeing: hot yoga, infrared yoga, wellness, and relaxation
BodyFix Gym NZ: group fitness classes, personal training, crèche, and more

sections.heading: Price Comparison
sections.body: The prices for Flow Yoga & Wellbeing and BodyFix Gym NZ vary, with Flow Yoga starting at $18.00 per week and BodyFix Gym starting at $18.00 per week. However, BodyFix Gym has a one-off joining fee of $49, while Flow Yoga has no joining fee.

sections.heading: Contract and Cancellation
sections.body: Both Flow Yoga & Wellbeing and BodyFix Gym NZ offer no lock-in contracts, giving you the flexibility to cancel your membership at any time. However, it's essential to review the terms and conditions of each gym to understand their cancellation policies.
list: No lock-in contracts for both Flow Yoga & Wellbeing and BodyFix Gym NZ
Cancellation policies vary, so review the terms and conditions carefully

sections.heading: Verdict and Recommendation
sections.body: Based on our comparison, we recommend Flow Yoga & Wellbeing for those who prioritize yoga, wellness, and relaxation. For group fitness enthusiasts who want variety and frequent training, BodyFix Gym NZ is the better choice. Additionally, eligible members can take advantage of Exercise NZ's subsidised gym scheme, which offers 40-70% off membership prices. Consider your fitness goals, budget, and preferences when making your decision, and don't forget to check out other NZ gym deals, such as Jetts 15% Off + 4 Weeks Free or Snap Fitness 6 Weeks Free.
